itemList.description: Dining table : 6 Seater - The overall dimension of the table should be 1800mm(W)x800mm (D)x750mm (H) The table top should be made of SS 204 grade 1mm thick brush finish stainless steel. The top frame assembly should be rectangular tube of dimensions 50.8mm X25.4mmX1.6 mm thick MS ERW and cylindrical socket which are welded and powder coated. The side frame assembly should be made of combination of circular and rectangular tubes of MS ERW. The circular should be of diameter 38.1mm and thickness .6mm. The circular should be of diameter 38.1mm and thickness 1.6mm. The rectangular tube should be of dimensions 50.8mm X 25.4 mm and thickness 1.6mm. Circular and rectangular tubes should be welded together to from the assembly. Side frame assembly should be fixed to top frame assembly. The stool top should be made SS-204 grade 1mm thick brush finish stainless steel with MS Ribs for strength. The stool top should heva an height of 450mm and the diameter of the stool top should be 300mm. The stool assembly should be foldable above the side frame. Cross members should be provided between side frame assembly. Cross members should be made of 50.8mm x 25.4mmx1.6mm thick MS ERW of 1.6mm thickness and should be powder coated. Finish should be epoxy polyster powder coated of 40-60 micron thickness. Shoe should be proided t the bottom.
